# `pointless-discard`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: semantic · Profile: none · Default: error · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports `_ = x;` for a local binding that is also referenced elsewhere, which
AstGen rejects as a pointless discard.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`_ = name;` tells the compiler that a binding is deliberately unused. When the
binding is used elsewhere, AstGen rejects the discard as "pointless discard of
local constant" (or variable, function parameter, capture), so the file does
not compile. The discard is typically left behind when code that uses the
value is added after a stub.

## When it fires

It reports `_ = name;` as a statement of its own when `name` is a local
constant or variable, a function parameter or a capture, and the scope index
resolves another reference in the binding's scope to that same binding:
reading it, assigning it or taking its address. Two discards with no other use are allowed, as by the compiler.
The span and message are the compiler's. The fix deletes the discard's line
and is applied by `check --fix`, since the binding stays used.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn double(value: u32) u32 {
    _ = value;
    return value * 2;
}
```
